[16-17] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오. (교재 p.170)
Hi! I am a plastic duck and am a bath toy. But look! I am not in a bathroom. I'm in the middle of the ocean. How did I get here?
I was from a factory with other ducks. People made us with plastic because it is light and lasts long. People put us in boxes and we went ⓐ______ to sea. But the boxes fell ⓑ______ the ocean ⓒ______ an accident.

[20-22] 다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오. (교재 p.171)
Then the waves took me to a giant trash island. I saw a lot of plastic waste. (A)난 거기서 빠져나가고 싶었어.
One day, a strong storm freed me. ⓐ______ weeks, I finally reached land. There were a lot of people ⓑ______ the beach. Oh, someone picked me up. "Where am I going now?," I thought.
